description: EPyT is the maintained OpenWaterAnalytics EPANET Python Toolkit. The existing EPANET record covers the C engine and toolkit but does not name this Python package, so the earlier duplicate mapping omits a separately maintained interface. The metadata is published or maintained by OpenWaterAnalytics. It describes a generic modelling method or tool. Its domain, time horizon and numerical resolution depend on the configuration; worldwide validation is not established. The repository provides software documentation and source access. The code was not installed or run. Licence: EUPL-1.2, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The review confirms resource metadata, not numerical accuracy, current operational use or completeness of underlying files. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. EPyT supplies a Python interface to model-epanet. The existing record describes the C engine and toolkit, but does not cover this separately maintained package.
